Taco Tuesday Ride at South Mountain

Phoenix, AZ · Ahwatukee · Mountain bike

Taco Tuesday Ride at South Mountain is a mountain bike group ride in Phoenix, AZ. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Kyrene de las Lomas Elementary School. About 7–12 miles, advanced beginner and up.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: advanced beginner and up.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Taco Tuesday Ride at South Mountain group ride

A Tuesday night mountain bike ride on South Mountain trails. Lights are required. Organizers ask for at least five prior mountain bike rides before you join. Distance depends on weather, usually 7–12 miles. Tacos after.
